themes.nameEn: audio cuts out during the night

reviews.text:
Sleep. It really helps me sleep I did accidentally spend like 47$ or a year but I like it I just wish it had updates!
I think they should add Cristal singing bowls or maybe even a race track in the distance or the sound of a house boat fishing they’re is a lot more potential

my go to sleep machine when traveling. this app has so many different possibilities that caters to whatever you’re in the mood for it’s really amazing. I’ve never had a sound machine that has so many options and let you build your sound.
👍. Love it. Helps me sleep better

I had it all the time. I have had this app for over a year and originally got it and used it then like we often do move on to a new better app!! Wrong, this is by far the only app for sleep specifically. I spent all the money for you…
Amazing sleep!!. I can’t say enough about this app!!! Way better than any other app I’ve ever tried!!!
The best. This is the best app ever I highly recommend it

Amazing restful sleep. I have been having a problem sleeping for awhile. I’ve tried medication, relaxing exercises and organic remedies. Nothing has helped for long. My husband found this app, he sent it to me as a last ditch effort to help me sleep. The crashing waves mixed with Deep Relaxation has done the trick. I have been sleeping all night for 2 months.
I can’t thank you enough. This truly works.
This app is amazing. It’s 7:30 and I feel like I’m going to sleep already

Works nicely with my hearing aid!. I'm hearing impaired and wear a bluetooth hearing aid. I wear it to bed, run the box fan sound from my iPhone, and have it play while wearing my hearing aid. My hubby doesn't hear it, so I'm set. It's part of my sleep routine now.
Sleep for all generous. This app is awesome and free. No hassle.
Not impressed. The sounds do not have a timer option and free trail does not give examples of what we are buying. I would like to hear examples.
My relaxing Buddy. This app is truly amazing! I would definitely recommend it…

Needs a tiny bit-o-tweaking. Needs more sounds.Better campfires,peepers, thunder and loud claps, driving rain and better thunder please. But I fall asleep like a baby. Good Show old chaps! I just want to dial up the sounds at a louder volume.

Sounds stop and you wake up to silence. I do fall asleep quickly to the sounds - but the sounds end in a short amount of time and I wake up to have to restart - this happens many times throughout the night - leading to a rough night of sleep!

WINNER !!!. I have used what I refer to as “sleep machines” for as long as they have been around and in truth must say that your sounds do indeed provide what they say they will . The GREEN sound is not only new to the many others I have enjoyed over decades , it has become my go to sound !

THANK YOU !!!

Rocke Roy

It worked then it didn’t. The app worked fine played a nice beach sound then 6 hours later it started playing a sound every few minutes that sounded like metal screws or washers being dropped on a sheet of heavy plastic. I didn’t like being awoken to that sound. Removed the app.

Try being less deceptive. They should tell you that the free sounds are very limited, or better yet, be upfront and charge for the app in the first place. Being deceptive doesn’t earn you any points with most people.

I. It was OK but there’s a lot of things you have to pay for and I was just like white noise. I didn’t like the fact that you could mix sounds but there are some sounds that were very useful and they should really tell you that you have to pay for before you go through the entire testing on like personalized white noise noise other than that I think there is an at may be better than that but are you just wanna run night and it’s OK?
All. W app but it dose have a paywall
Pay for it?. Why doesn’t it say before you download it that it’s gonna cost money?!!!!!!
So good. This app is so great it made me go to sleep in minutes

Only 1 hour limit. I understand there's only a few sounds that are unlocked and free, but I don't like the fact that the maximum time limit to play the sound is only 1 hour unless you pay for a subscription. There are already many free nature and rain sounds apps which don't have a time limit. Not very good app.
Question. why dont you make more things for free? thanks while playing this i am asleep but im tired of listening to the same stuff!!! plus the premium costs to much for me to get
